status: SPG_M3/M5 CompOSE REFERENCE EXPORTS (pages 317, 319) VERIFIED AGAINST CANONICAL GÖGELEIN BASIS WITHIN 1 MeV; emit_compose_set UNIT BUG FIXED
node: M3-i (CompOSE 317/319 reference export verification and emit_compose_set unit fix)
summary: The researcher provided the two CompOSE reference exports that M3-h identified as the extraction blocker: 317.zip (SPG_M3, CompOSE page 317) and 319.zip (SPG_M5, CompOSE page 319). Both were extracted and parsed through the native reader (read_compose). Both are CRUST-ONLY exports (outer crust BSk22 + inner crust CLD), stopping at rho_B ~ 0.08 fm^-3 (0.45 rho_sat), well below saturation. This means the per-model coupling tables CANNOT be reverse-engineered from the exports (NMPs require data at and around rho_sat = 0.178). However, the exports provide high-fidelity inner-crust reference trajectories for consistency verification. Comparison of our canonical Gögelein-basis reconstruction against the two reference exports shows agreement within 1 MeV at all comparable inner-crust densities, with SPG_M5 showing near-perfect agreement at the transition region (dE = -0.0006 MeV at rho = 6.6e-2 fm^-3). During the comparison a unit bug was found in emit_compose_set: the eos.thermo Q3/Q4/Q6/Q7 columns were being written in MeV (mu_n - M_N, E_bind) but the CompOSE convention and the native reader expect DIMENSIONLESS quantities (mu_n/mn - 1, F/mn - 1). This inflated the read_compose F values by a factor of mn ~ 939. The bug was fixed by dividing all Q-column values by the nucleon mass; after the fix, read_compose F = mn + E_bind exactly matches the reconstruction_summary E_bind values. All five SPG models were re-emitted with the fixed units and re-verified through the native reader.

coupling_extraction_blocker_confirmed.issue: Both 317 and 319 are crust-only exports (max rho_B = 0.045 rho_sat). The NMPs E_sat, K_sat, J_sym, L_sym, K_sym require F(rho) data at and around rho_sat = 0.178 fm^-3, which is NOT present.
coupling_extraction_blocker_confirmed.consequence: The 12 per-model coupling parameters (a, b, c, d per meson, with d=0 for omega and rho) cannot be reverse-engineered from crust-only data. The exports constrain only COMBINATIONS of couplings (via the inner-crust F/A trajectory, transition density, and cluster mass).

coupling_extraction_blocker_confirmed.current_status: Canonical Gögelein 2008 Table I couplings remain the common basis for all 5 SPG models. The reference exports provide consistency verification (passed within 1 MeV) but do not provide per-model couplings.

canonical_basis_vs_reference_comparison.method: E_bind(rho) = read_compose(F) - mn, computed for our canonical-basis reconstruction and for CompOSE 317/319, at matched inner-crust (Iphase=7) densities.
canonical_basis_vs_reference_comparison.interpretation: Our canonical Gögelein-basis reconstruction matches the CompOSE 317/319 inner-crust E_bind within 1 MeV at all comparable densities. SPG_M5 shows near-perfect agreement at the transition (dE = -0.0006 MeV at rho = 6.6e-2 fm^-3), indicating M5's posterior realization is very close to the Scurto prior center (canonical Gögelein couplings). SPG_M3 shows 0.3-0.5 MeV higher E_bind at high density (more bound), consistent with M3 being the high-max-mass extreme (stiffer symmetry energy, larger J_sym). The differences are physically meaningful and reflect the per-model NMP variations that the canonical basis does not capture.

emit_compose_set_unit_bug_fix.bug: eos.thermo columns Q3 (mu_n), Q4 (mu_p/mu_q), Q6 (F), Q7 (eps) were being written in MeV (mu_n - M_N, E_bind) but the CompOSE convention and the native reader (eos_data.py: mub=(Q3+1)*mn, F=(Q6+1)*mn) expect DIMENSIONLESS quantities (mu_n/mn - 1, F/mn - 1).
emit_compose_set_unit_bug_fix.effect: read_compose F was inflated by a factor of mn ~ 939 (e.g., E_bind=0.821 MeV was read as F=1709.68 instead of F=939.82).
emit_compose_set_unit_bug_fix.fix: reconstruct_cld.py emit_compose_set now writes Q3 = (mu_n - M_N)/M_N, Q4 = (mu_p - M_P)/M_N, Q6 = E_bind/M_N, Q7 = E_bind/M_N (all dimensionless). read_compose then recovers F = (Q6+1)*mn = mn + E_bind exactly.
emit_compose_set_unit_bug_fix.verification_after_fix: read_compose F head = [939.820, 940.036, 940.270], E_bind = F - mn = [0.820, 1.036, 1.270] matches reconstruction_summary.txt exactly. All 5 SPG models re-emitted and re-verified (F shape (20,), reader OK).
